dim_sets.name: kw_set
dim_sets.build: linear scan 134170 rows with strcmp against 4 literals; store matching ids in flat array

dim_sets.name: cn_set
dim_sets.build: scan country_code.bin, set bit where code != us_code AND code != 0

dim_sets.name: mi_info_set
dim_sets.structure: small string set (10 fixed C-strings) with length-prefixed compare

filters.notes: highly selective; only ~0.1% of mk rows match

filters.predicate: company_id ∈ cn_set AND note != NULL AND memmem(note,'(USA)')==NULL AND memmem(note,'(200')!=NULL AND ')' after '(200'

filters.notes: it1=countries narrows to ~1.5M rows; then 10 country strings ~5%

join_order.notes: outer driver loop; row-parallel over title id range
capture cn.name (via company_id) for MIN; note LIKE checks via memmem
LAST because movie_info is largest (14.8M rows) — only run if all earlier predicates pass

data_structures.dim_ids: scalar int32 each (crew_id, verified_id, us_code, it1_id, it2_id, kt_movie_id, kt_episode_id)
data_structures.aggregation: 3 thread-local scalars: min_cn_name(string), min_mi_idx_info(string), min_title(string); reduced at end
data_structures.no_hash_tables_needed: All joins reduce to FK-indexed array probes via *__movie_id offsets indexes

parallelism.reduction: per-thread min-string locals; final tournament reduction of 3 MIN values across threads

early_exit_strategy.per_title: Short-circuit fact probes in selectivity order: mk (semi) → cc (semi) → mi_idx (capture rating) → mc (capture cn.name + note checks) → mi (semi). Skip remaining probes as soon as any required semi-join fails.
early_exit_strategy.mk_first: Cheapest probe with kw_set membership eliminates ~99.9% of titles before touching cc/mi_idx/mc/mi.
early_exit_strategy.mi_last: movie_info has 14.8M rows; defer until all other joins succeed
early_exit_strategy.mi_idx_short_circuit: On first matching mi_idx row, capture info and break (only need MIN; track in thread-local).
early_exit_strategy.mc_short_circuit: On first matching mc row pass note + cn_set, capture cn.name and break.

varlen_handling.load: mmap .off + .dat for all varlen columns (kind, name, country_code dict, info, keyword, title, note)
varlen_handling.compare: length-prefixed memcmp; for LIKE, use memmem on note bytes
varlen_handling.min_strings: store best-so-far as (const uint8_t* ptr, uint32_t len); replace if memcmp < 0
